name: 4th Floor
source:
Inside a room in a deteriorating building lies a lost man trying to keep his life together; however, things begin to go very wrong for him.

[From [url=https://four-guys-in-a-trenchcoat.itch.io/4th-floor]Itch.io[/url]]

在一座破旧建筑的一个房间里，躺着一个迷路的人，他试图维持自己的生活。然而，事情开始变得非常糟糕。
